_comment: Purpose: example criteria for a fictional review of digital self-management programs in adults with type 2 diabetes. Thresholds are illustrative defaults, not calibrated values.
review: Digital self-management programs and glycaemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes

inclusion.statement: The study population consists of adults with type 2 diabetes
inclusion.true: Participants are adults (18 years or older) diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, or a mixed sample where adults with type 2 diabetes are clearly the main group.
inclusion.false: Participants are children, animals, cell lines, people with type 1 or gestational diabetes only, people at risk of diabetes, or people with another condition.

inclusion.statement: The study evaluates a digital self-management program such as a smartphone app, text messages, a web platform or remote monitoring with automated feedback
inclusion.true: A digital tool delivers education, coaching, reminders, monitoring feedback or support directly to the participant.
inclusion.false: The intervention is a drug, a device without a digital program, face-to-face education only, or there is no intervention.

inclusion.statement: The study reports a glycaemic outcome such as HbA1c or blood glucose
inclusion.true: HbA1c, fasting glucose, time in range or another glycaemic measure is reported as a result.
inclusion.false: Only usability, acceptance, cost, quality of life or process outcomes are reported.

exclusion.statement: The study is conducted in animals or in vitro only
exclusion.true: The subjects are animals, tissues or cell cultures.

exclusion.statement: The study includes only people with type 1 diabetes
exclusion.true: Every participant has type 1 diabetes and no type 2 group is studied.
exclusion.false: Type 2 diabetes participants are part of the study, or the type is not restricted to type 1.

exclusion.statement: The record is a review, editorial, protocol, modelling study or conference abstract without original participant results
exclusion.true: It summarises other studies, states an opinion, describes a planned study, or models costs without collecting participant outcomes.
exclusion.false: It reports original results collected from participants.
